description: Ferry routes for the Isles of Britain atlas. Each route is one operator + one origin/destination pair. Schedules are kept in route.timetable.weekly. Routes are merged from OSM (route=ferry), Wikipedia operator pages, CalMac GTFS, per-operator scrapers, and manual entries in data/ferries_manual.json. See docs/FERRIES.md.

schema.operatorRouteCode: operator's own code if any (CalMac route codes etc.)
schema.name: human label e.g. 'Oban - Craignure (Isle of Mull)'

from.islandId: FK to data/islands.json or null if mainland

to.islandId: FK to data/islands.json or null if mainland

schema.bookingUrl: URL to the operator booking page (NOT an affiliate link; that is rendered separately by UI)
